snippet.description:
For some, festive lights are a tradition. For others, there was a time when simply seeing the whole village lit up felt special.

Mukesh Barnwal (AIR 465) recalls studying under a lamp and why the 10 days around Ram Navami became one of the happiest memories of his childhood.

Sometimes, the simplest memories stay with us the longest. ❤️

For course enrollment, call at 8826496658
